configurations.hypothesis: Rising price with rising OI indicates new long leverage and continuation.
configurations.invalidation: The closed 1h price/OI impulse reverses before execution.
configurations.exit: ATR risk template target, trailing trend exit, or time stop.

configurations.hypothesis: Rising price with falling OI indicates short covering and continuation.
configurations.invalidation: The closed 1h price impulse fails or OI expands against the covering move.
configurations.exit: ATR risk template target, trailing trend exit, or time stop.

configurations.hypothesis: Falling price with rising OI indicates new short leverage and continuation.
configurations.invalidation: The closed 1h price/OI impulse reverses before execution.
configurations.exit: ATR risk template target, trailing trend exit, or time stop.

configurations.hypothesis: Falling price with falling OI indicates long liquidation and continuation.
configurations.invalidation: The closed 1h liquidation impulse reverses before execution.
configurations.exit: ATR risk template target, trailing trend exit, or time stop.

configurations.hypothesis: OI acceleration with aggressive selling and a breakdown identifies new short pressure.
configurations.invalidation: The closed 1h breakdown or aggressive sell imbalance is absent.
configurations.exit: ATR risk template target, trailing trend exit, or time stop.

configurations.hypothesis: OI acceleration with aggressive buying and a breakout identifies new long pressure.
configurations.invalidation: The closed 1h breakout or aggressive buy imbalance is absent.
configurations.exit: ATR risk template target, trailing trend exit, or time stop.

configurations.hypothesis: A breakdown confirmed by expanding OI and aggressive selling captures flow-led continuation.
configurations.invalidation: The closed candle does not break its prior 4h range or flow is not net selling.
configurations.exit: ATR risk template target, trailing trend exit, or time stop.

configurations.hypothesis: A breakout confirmed by expanding OI and aggressive buying captures flow-led continuation.
configurations.invalidation: The closed candle does not break its prior 4h range or flow is not net buying.
configurations.exit: ATR risk template target, trailing trend exit, or time stop.

configurations.hypothesis: Crowded longs with positive funding, high OI and price exhaustion can unwind lower.
configurations.invalidation: Crowding is not jointly confirmed by funding, global ratio, OI and exhaustion.
configurations.exit: ATR risk template target, trailing trend exit, or time stop.

configurations.hypothesis: Crowded shorts with negative funding, low global ratio, high OI and price exhaustion can unwind higher.
configurations.invalidation: Crowding is not jointly confirmed by funding, global ratio, OI and exhaustion.
configurations.exit: ATR risk template target, trailing trend exit, or time stop.

configurations.hypothesis: An exhausted upward move with crowded long positioning is vulnerable to reversal.
configurations.invalidation: The closed 4h move is not extreme relative to its realized volatility.
configurations.exit: ATR risk template target, trailing trend exit, or time stop.

configurations.hypothesis: An exhausted downward move with crowded short positioning is vulnerable to reversal.
configurations.invalidation: The closed 4h move is not extreme relative to its realized volatility.
configurations.exit: ATR risk template target, trailing trend exit, or time stop.

rules: Derivatives-flow data must be public, immutable and frozen before any out-of-sample return is read.
Signal timeframe is closed 1h; 4h is context; 15m supplies only the next executable open.
Every feature timestamp must be at or before the closed 1h signal timestamp.
Only the 3 preregistered families and 12 configurations are evaluated; liquidation family is removed without reliable history.
Nested purged walk-forward uses 24h purge and 24h embargo; outer OOS is primary.
Validation A is a frozen temporal segment and Validation B is a pre-registered symbol holdout.
No family can be promoted without nested, temporal and symbol validation gates plus cost and yield gates.
